CustomField.description: Which set of fields on this record is actually used to scramble data. RandomizeByPattern uses ReplacementPattern__c, Redact__c and ReplacementCharacterCount__c. SubstituteFromList uses SubstituteValues__c.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: RandomizeByPattern: replace characters matching a regex pattern with random characters of the same type (digit/letter). SubstituteFromList: replace the whole value with a random pick from a comma-separated list of dummy data.
CustomField.label: Strategy
